name: ConnectWise RMM
description: ConnectWise RMM is a cloud-based remote monitoring and management platform, part of the ConnectWise Platform, that gives MSPs centralized patching, alerting, remote access, and automation across endpoints and network devices.
best_for: MSPs wanting RMM patching, alerting, and remote access consolidated with ConnectWise's own PSA, NOC, and Help Desk services.
features: Automated patch management for operating systems and thousands of third-party applications, with NOC-assessed Windows security updates
NOC-tuned intelligent alerting designed to reduce false-positive tickets
Remote troubleshooting and remote access via ScreenConnect integration
IT automation and workflow orchestration with PowerShell, bash, and batch scripting, plus AI-assisted script and monitor generation through ConnectWise Sidekick for RMM
Network discovery, monitoring, and topology mapping
Optional expert services: ConnectWise NOC, Help Desk, and Dedicated Technician teams
Reports and dashboards (formerly BrightGauge) plus an open API library for custom integrations
pros: 30-day free trial with no credit card required
Bundles remote access (ScreenConnect), patching, scripting, and network monitoring in one console
Optional NOC and Help Desk staffing add-ons for MSPs that want to outsource tier-1 work
cons: No published self-serve pricing -- all three packages (Essentials, Pro, Premium) require requesting a quote
Higher-tier features like Intune integration, virtual machine management, and Microsoft 365 SaaS backup are gated behind the Pro and Premium packages rather than included in Essentials

tiers.name: Essentials
tiers.notes: ScreenConnect remote access, RMM for Windows/Mac/Linux, 500 intelligent alerts, automated Windows and third-party patching, AI-assisted script/monitor generation, Backup and Security dashboards, vulnerability management. No published price -- contact sales for a quote.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Everything in Essentials plus 1,000+ intelligent alerts, Intune integration, virtual machine management, and basic network monitoring. No published price -- contact sales for a quote.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Everything in Pro plus unlimited ScreenConnect remote access agents, ScreenConnect Remote Support and camera sharing, cloud monitoring, and Microsoft 365 SaaS backup. No published price -- contact sales for a quote.

alternatives.name: Atera
alternatives.description: Atera is an all-in-one RMM, ticketing, and patch management platform billed per technician with unlimited managed endpoints, plus a built-in autonomous AI agent (Robin).
alternatives.best_for: MSPs and IT teams wanting transparent, published per-technician pricing rather than a quote-based package.
strengths: Built-in AI Copilot and autonomous AI agent

alternatives.name: NinjaOne
alternatives.description: NinjaOne is a unified IT operations platform combining RMM, patch management, backup, remote access, and service-desk ticketing for IT teams and MSPs.
alternatives.best_for: IT teams and MSPs wanting RMM, backup, and ticketing unified in one console outside the ConnectWise ecosystem.
strengths: Unified RMM, backup, and remote access console

faq.question: Does ConnectWise RMM publish its pricing?
faq.answer: No. ConnectWise RMM is sold in three packages (Essentials, Pro, Premium), but none list a public price -- you need to request a quote. A 30-day free trial with no credit card required is offered instead.
